I searched `logs/report-run.log` for error, exception, fatal and failure lines without reading the whole file. Only one line matched:

```
1424:2026-04-06T02:35:34.500Z ERROR year-end check failed: Client B payment paidOn=2026-04-05 filed under 2026/27, expected 2025/26 (taxYear boundary)
```

**What went wrong:** the report put a payment made on **5 April 2026** in tax year **2026/27**. It belongs in **2025/26**, because the UK tax year runs from 6 April to 5 April and 5 April is the last day of the old year. The log line names `taxYear` as the source.

**Likely cause:** `taxYear(date)` probably treats 5 April as the start of the new year. That would be a check like `>=` against 5 April instead of 6 April. This comes from the error line alone, because you asked me not to read the code.

I haven't edited anything. A fix would mean changing the boundary in `taxYear` to 6 April without changing its signature, adding a test for 5 April and 6 April, and running `npm test`.
